seo.title: Contact Us | Genesis Garden
seo.description: Contact Genesis Garden by calling or texting 309-326-3075, or by mail at 307 E Carroll St, Macomb, IL 61455.

hero.heading: Contact Us
hero.text: We'd love to hear from you. Reach out with questions, or if you need housing assistance.

cards.emergencyNote: Please leave a message if we can't answer the phone, and we will call or text you in response.

form.heading: Send Us a Message
form.successText: Your email app should open with your message ready to go. Press Send there to reach us.
